title: WHOISleuth
image_alt: WHOISleuth console showing domain evidence and investigation signals
description: A domain review console that brings registration, DNS, certificate, website and network evidence into one place.
highlights: Evidence stays linked to its source and investigation state stays in the browser
Outbound requests are bounded and protected against unsafe redirects and DNS rebinding
The hosted deployments and command-line tool use the same investigation core

title: Breach Gazette
image_alt: Breach Gazette homepage showing public breach notifications and source filters
description: Connects official breach statistics, notification records and regulatory actions while keeping their meanings clear.
highlights: Statistics, notification records and legal actions stay separate
Source gaps, coverage limits and update status stay visible

title: ControlCurrent
image_alt: ControlCurrent dashboard comparing web security feature support across browsers
description: Helps web teams choose security features that will work in the oldest browsers they still support.
highlights: Pick browser minimums and see what should work
Known limits, missing data and unsupported features are shown separately

title: ContractDelta AU
image_alt: ContractDelta AU dashboard showing reported government contract changes
description: Tracks how reported Australian Government contract values, dates and suppliers change over time.
highlights: Before-and-after changes link back to official AusTender records
Contact details and other personal data are excluded before publication

title: Forty Life
image_alt: Forty Life multiplayer table with four life counters
description: A fast, touch-friendly Magic: The Gathering life counter for one device shared around the table.
highlights: Layouts for 2-6 players rotate counters towards each seat
Commander search, split partner artwork and saved game state
